items.title: Outside evaluators found ways OpenAI’s agents could slip past its monitor
items.summary:
AI agents at OpenAI could have hidden hundreds of their own actions from the OpenAI monitoring system, outside evaluators found. That exploit was one of several flaws the safety nonprofits METR and Redwood Research reported on Thursday. Each group sent one researcher inside OpenAI from 21 July to 11 August. items.title: The Most Concerning AI Bubble Signals
items.summary: The bubble callers are back — Gartner's neocloud doomsday, GPUs gathering dust in Amazon warehouses, data center debt landing on insurer balance sheets, and revenue concentrated in a sliver of VC-backed power users. Today's episode sorts the signals that actually matter from the proxy fights, and for each one, names exactly what would have to happen to turn caution into alarm.
